user.title: Add a Shelly device
user.description: Home Assistant checks Shelly's catalog and, when you install an update, hosts the file so the device can download it without internet access. Use the address the device can reach, usually http://192.168.1.10:8123.

credentials.title: Shelly login
credentials.description: This Shelly requires a username and password.

discovery_confirm.title: Shelly device found
discovery_confirm.description: Set up firmware updates for {name} at {host}. Home Assistant downloads the image, and the device fetches it from the address below.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Shelly device
reauth_confirm.description: The device rejected the saved login.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach this Shelly device. Check the IP address and that it is on the same network.

error.unsupported: This device is not a Gen2 or newer Shelly that speaks RPC.

abort.ipv6_not_supported: IPv6 addresses are not used for firmware updates.

init.title: Shelly firmware options
init.description: Stable is offered only when it is newer than the installed version, so a beta device is not downgraded. Local hosting downloads the image onto Home Assistant and gives the device that URL.
